Medium Speed Changer device (MSO) 
to adjust speed of turbine.

NOTE: Speed 
changer device is used to increase the turbine speed from heating speed (1200 rpm) 
to phasing speed (3000 rpm) when the conditions are OK (steam temp., steam 
pressure, turbine casing temp., turbine shaft temp. .......etc)

This document outlines the testing procedure P1, which performed every six 
months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

Unit in service under speed 
 control (before phasing) i.e Not synchronizing

Digital 
 Multimeter type -Fluke 85 at what step you used it ??

Change from parallel mode to Hygo Mode by 
 pushing bottom Hygo from control panel then speed will increases automatically more 
 than 3000 rpm (from15
 to 
 25 rpm).

Decrease speed by M.S.O (medium speed 
 changer) manually to 2980 RPM and increase again to 3000 RPM
 by using the push bottom H / A in 
 Automatic mode then Indication lamp of 3000 
 RPM light go (off).

Change setting from the comparator (A33) 
 in diamo cabinet no: HC11 until lamp of 3000 RPM comes on and change to 
 Parallel Mode again.
 Note: When Changing from parallel to Hygo, speed increase from 15 to 
 25 rpm

Change from Hygo 
 mode to parallel mode 
and m.s.o open 60% to return the circuit into service

text:
Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
Medium Speed Changer device (MSO) 
to adjust speed of turbine.
NOTE: Speed 
changer device is used to increase the turbine speed from heating speed (1200 rpm) 
to phasing speed (3000 rpm) when the conditions are OK (steam temp., steam 
pressure, turbine casing temp., turbine shaft temp. .......etc)
This document outlines the testing procedure P1, which performed every six 
months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid, tested by eng. Ashraf Farid at 
22 June 2003, revised by
EDEPCo.
quality control eng. Abdl Menem Al Emam, 
accepted by general director: eng. Aly Abd El-Whab, and approved by eng. Awad 
Mohamed Fathy; Head Sector of Talkha Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear your safety helmet, shoes
 . etc
Unit in service under speed 
 control (before phasing) i.e Not synchronizing
Tools and Equipment
Digital 
 Multimeter type -Fluke 85 at what step you used it ??
Screw driver.
Work to be carried out
Change from parallel mode to Hygo Mode by 
 pushing bottom Hygo from control panel then speed will increases automatically more 
 than 3000 rpm (from15
 to 
 25 rpm).
Decrease speed by M.S.O (medium speed 
 changer) manually to 2980 RPM and increase again to 3000 RPM
 by using the push bottom H / A in 
 Automatic mode then Indication lamp of 3000 
 RPM light go (off).
Change setting from the comparator (A33) 
 in diamo cabinet no: HC11 until lamp of 3000 RPM comes on and change to 
 Parallel Mode again.
 Note: When Changing from parallel to Hygo, speed increase from 15 to 
 25 rpm
Change from Hygo 
 mode to parallel mode 
and m.s.o open 60% to return the circuit into service
